objective: Recover safely from corrupted signed-update cache receipts.
chosenApproach: Validate both incoming and existing receipts before updating the commit point.
selectionRationale: Preserves valid receipts and enables retries after invalid cache state.
alternativeApproaches: Unconditional overwrite could replace a valid revision.
preserveBehaviors: Signed manifests, bundle hash validation and offline fallback
acceptanceChecks: Corrupt cache can recover and valid signed conflicts are rejected.
